title: Copper Hopper N Rails
description: Copper replaces Iron in the Hopper, Rails, Activator Rails, and Detector Rails recipes. Can be paired with a resource pack that changes the items looks accordingly.
body:
## **Copper Hopper N Rails**
Changes the crafting recipes for the hopper, activator rails, detector rails, and the normal rails to use copper ingots instead of iron. Comes with a resource pack that makes the hopper (including the hopper in a hopper minecart) and all rails to be copper textured.
